name: GlassSegmentedControl
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass elevation level1 as track; each segment is a full GlassButton (variant primary when selected, secondary otherwise). No sliding thumb, so selection reads as a row of separate buttons, not one segmented material. material='liquid' delegates to LiquidGlassSegmentedControl.
motion: OptimizedGlass animation 'gentle' vs 'none' via useReducedMotion + respectMotionPreference (wired, L60-61, L90). No selection-indicator motion at all.
a11y: Outer <nav aria-label> wraps a role=group with the SAME aria-label (double landmark/label; a segmented control is not navigation). Segments use aria-pressed toggle buttons instead of radiogroup/radio or tablist semantics; no roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation. condensed=true hides labels with no aria-label fallback -> icon-only buttons without accessible names (L117).
api: forwardRef (ref lands on inner OptimizedGlass, while className lands on outer nav - split targets). No style passthrough, no ...rest. Controlled only (value default '', onChange noop) - no defaultValue. Size sm/md/lg. items typed but mapped as any (L99). Liquid branch ignores size/condensed.
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. Imports Liquid variant eagerly.
target: single SegmentedControl (merge with LiquidGlassSegmentedControl and GlassToggleGroup)
justification: A segmented control is a signature Liquid Glass component (iOS/macOS), so it should be a flagship, but this implementation is a row of independent GlassButtons inside a glass track with no shared sliding thumb, wrong landmark semantics (nav + group with duplicate labels), no arrow-key/radio semantics, and icon-only mode loses accessible names. Two parallel implementations (glass vs liquid) with different prop names (items/onChange vs segments/onValueChange). Redesign as one component with a measured, spring-animated thumb on the liquid material, radiogroup semantics, controlled/uncontrolled, and consolidate the duplicates into it.

name: LiquidGlassSegmentedControl
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + LiquidGlassEffectGroup primitives, but then overrides the material background with a hard-coded inline gradient rgba(255,255,255,.28)->.14 (L46-48), defeating the material's adaptive tinting. Segment buttons use inline border rgba(255,255,255,0.3) and selected background rgba(255,255,255,0.28) - white-on-white on light backdrops.
motion: None of its own; relies on LiquidGlassMaterial (which reads useReducedMotion internally). No selection thumb animation.
a11y: role=group without aria-label default; aria-pressed buttons; no arrow keys. Inline style color forces text-secondary on ALL segments (L72), overriding the selected 'glass-text-primary' class (L67) - selected segment has no text-weight/color distinction, only a faint white fill.
api: forwardRef, className + ...props passthrough (props spread after style, so a user style prop REPLACES the gradient). Controlled only. density prop only sets data-density (L49) - no styling effect found.
justification: Thin wrapper that uses the right primitives then neutralises them with hard-coded white rgba fills; selected state is barely distinguishable because inline color overrides the selected class; density is fake; 1-line test. Fold its primitive usage into the redesigned single SegmentedControl and delete.

name: GlassSidebar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (intent neutral, level1/level2, border subtle/gradient) - shared primitive. But toggle button is bespoke: glass-backdrop-blur-lg + bg-white/25 + inline backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.28) + arbitrary Tailwind shadow (L266-278). Badges bespoke bg-white/24 border-white/30 shadow-md. Status dots raw Tailwind bg-green-500/yellow/red/gray (L709-713). Active item class is a single-quoted string containing a literal '${glassStyles.borderColor ...}' (L491) - broken class, active ring never applies.
motion: Motion primitive slideRight for overlay, slideDown for children. Dynamic Tailwind classes duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] (L349, L484, L521, L545) are interpolated at runtime and will not be generated by Tailwind JIT. No explicit reduced-motion handling in this file (depends on Motion primitive).
a11y: OptimizedGlass role=navigation with label; items are buttons even when item.href is provided (href ignored entirely - no links, no aria-current). Parent items lack aria-expanded/aria-controls. Items set focus:outline-none (L485). Collapsed mode uses tooltips (good). Status dot is color-only. Toggle has aria-label + touch target.
api: forwardRef with manual ref merge. BUG: isCollapsed = collapsed ?? internalCollapsed (L177) with collapsed defaulting to false (L152) -> uncontrolled collapse toggle never works (internal state ignored); stories mask it by controlling collapsed. BUG: early return 'if (variant === overlay && !open) return null' (L216) precedes useLayoutEffect/useEffect (L235, L257) - Rules of Hooks violation, toggling open crashes React with hook-count mismatch. Default expansion hard-coded to item id 'home' (L459). Toggle portaled to document.body at viewport-fixed position measured from getBoundingClientRect (L397-414) - fragile in scroll containers/iframes. SidebarBrand/SidebarUserInfo define inner Content components per render (remount each render). data-glass-component passed to Context.Provider (L295) - meaningless.
ssr: 'use client'. createPortal guarded by mounted flag; window listeners in layout effect. OK for SSR but useLayoutEffect warns on server.
fake_complexity: Moderate: 'advanced features' doc claims; portal toggle positioning is over-engineered; toggleable uncontrolled state is fake (doesn't work).
target: single Sidebar in app-shell (merge LiquidGlassInsetSidebar, GlassSidebarRail/Panel)
justification: The sidebar is a core app-shell flagship surface, but this one has two real correctness bugs (uncontrolled collapse never toggles; hooks after a conditional return crash when overlay open flips), a broken active-state class, ignored hrefs (no real links / aria-current), runtime-interpolated Tailwind classes that never compile, and a body-portaled toggle that is positioned by measuring the viewport. It duplicates three other sidebars. Redesign one sidebar on the liquid material with proper link semantics, disclosure semantics for groups, controlled/uncontrolled state and an in-flow toggle.

name: SidebarBrand / SidebarUserInfo
material_impl: No glass; plain flex layout. Avatar fallback uses glass-surface-primary/20; status dots hard-coded Tailwind bg-green-500 etc.
a11y: Status conveyed by color only; img alt=name OK; h1 used for brand title inside sidebar (L622) - wrong heading level for a component.
api: Plain functions, no forwardRef; must be inside GlassSidebar context (throws otherwise). Inner Content component recreated each render (L606, L723).
target: Sidebar slots in redesigned app-shell Sidebar; use GlassAvatar
justification: Not exported from root (only module-level exports), unstoried, untested, and re-implements avatar/status that GlassAvatar already has. Fold into slot API of the redesigned sidebar.

name: GlassTabBar
material_impl: Container: styled.tsx TabBarContainer -> OptimizedGlassCore plus CSS module backdrop-filter (GlassTabBar.module.css:10-19) - double blur layer (OptimizedGlass + module). Selector: CSS module selectorBase with tokenised color-mix gradients (decent). Tabs: components/TabItem with inline rgba(255,255,255,0.28) active bg, borderRadius 6px, 0.875rem font, transition all - bespoke and off-token. Magnetic trail uses hard-coded 60px slots (L1101) and var(--color-${color}-transparent) tokens that do not exist in the token system.
motion: Claims physics/spring; reality: hand-rolled RAF momentum scroll with bounce (L670-759), mouse-drag scrolling on the container, 'magnetic' transform state. useTabAnimations results (animateToTab, selectorPosition...) are destructured and never used (L184-191). MagneticTrailEffect useCallback component is defined but never rendered (L992-1030). physics prop converted to finalAnimationConfig that is never consumed. Reduced motion via useAccessibilitySettings disables selector transform (wired partially), but the magnetic overlay and momentum scroll still run off isReducedMotion only through friction tweak.
a11y: role=tablist + aria-orientation on container; TabItem role=tab, aria-selected, roving tabindex, internal arrow-key handler. But GlassTabBar's own handleKeyDown (L342-421) is never attached to anything. No aria-controls wiring. Mouse-down on the container starts drag-scroll and mousemove preventDefault (L585), interfering with text selection/clicks. Mobile forces labels off (L108) but effectiveShowLabels is never passed to tabs, so it's dead.
api: forwardRef to an imperative handle (TabBarRef) - not a DOM ref. CRITICAL BUG: setTabRef is created per tab (L1122) but never passed to TabItemComponent (which is a non-forwardRef FC), so tabRefs.current is always empty -> selector never positions, scrollTabIntoView never runs, imperative getTabElement returns null, collapseTabs measurement bails (L965). BUG: '!activeTab' guards (L767, L874) treat index 0 as no selection. BUG: with collapseTabs, clicking the last visible real tab toggles the More menu even when nothing is collapsed (L305). toggleBadge/updateBadge are empty stubs (L279-286). onChange signature (event, index) differs from the rest of the library (value strings). 30+ props, many no-ops (glassVariant, iconPosition, placement, verticalDisplayMode, tabStyle, tabClassName, activeTabClassName, badgeStyle, defaultBadgeAnimation, responsiveConfig).
ssr: 'use client'; useResponsive reads window in hooks; document.createElement in callbacks only. OK.
fake_complexity: High. 'Physics-based animations' and 'magnetic' selector are largely dead code; selector is non-functional because refs are never attached; story uses variant default which renders no selector at all, masking it. ~60% of 1200 lines is unused or broken machinery.
target: GlassTabs (redesigned headless-tablist with animated liquid indicator)
justification: 1,200 lines of fake complexity: the 'physics' selector cannot work because tab refs are never attached, index-0 is treated as unselected, the component's own keyboard handler and magnetic-trail component are never wired, and a dozen props are no-ops. Its value (pill indicator CSS in the module) can be salvaged into a single Tabs implementation. Replace with the consolidated GlassTabs and keep GlassTabBar as a deprecated alias for one major.

name: TabBarContainer / TabSelector (styled.tsx)
material_impl: OptimizedGlassCore + CSS module; blur mapped to --glass-blur-* tokens with px fallbacks (L12-17). Background=false uses inline transparent + module !important override. Most $-props become data-attributes with no CSS consuming them ($glassVariant, $iconPosition, $placement, $color).
motion: CSS transitions on left/top/width/height (layout-thrashing properties) in module; disableAnimation sets transition none.
api: forwardRef; legacy styled-components-style $props retained after migration.
ssr: No 'use client' but no browser access; fine.
target: absorbed into consolidated Tabs indicator styles
justification: Internal leftovers from a styled-components migration; only GlassTabBar uses them. The selector gradient CSS is the one reusable asset; move it into the consolidated tabs stylesheet and animate with transform instead of left/width.

name: GlassTabItem
material_impl: Fully bespoke inline styles: hard-coded padding 12px 20px, fontSize 14px, fallback #5ac8ff accent and #05111d text (L51, L135), rgba(99,102,241,0.3) focus ring fallback. Injects a <style> block per instance (L162-200) that sets hover background to the FULL accent color with !important - opaque cyan hover, not glass. Not a glass surface at all.
motion: Inline transition via useReducedMotion plus @media reduced-motion in injected CSS (wired). But the active underline indicator is removed entirely when reduced motion is on (L145) - state information lost, not just motion.
a11y: role=tab on an <a> when href is set (link-as-tab is wrong); every item tabIndex 0 (no roving), no aria-controls, no tablist parent required. focus-visible ring present (good).
api: forwardRef with 'as any'; no ...rest passthrough (aria/data attrs dropped); polymorphic only via href. Standalone - not composable with GlassTabs or GlassTabBar (third tab item implementation alongside components/TabItem and GlassTabsTrigger).
ssr: 'use client'; per-instance <style> tags duplicate N times in DOM.
justification: A third standalone tab-item implementation with off-token inline styles, a per-instance injected stylesheet with a garish !important accent hover, link-as-tab semantics, and an indicator that disappears under reduced motion. Nothing composes it. Deprecate in favour of the trigger of the consolidated Tabs.

name: GlassTabs (GlassTabs, GlassTabsList, GlassTabsTrigger, GlassTabsContent)
material_impl: List uses OptimizedGlass (variant ethereal, intensity subtle) for default/pills; triggers use GlassButton + glass-surface-* utility classes - shared primitives. Mixes raw Tailwind (rounded-2xl, after:bg-primary, focus-visible:ring-primary) with glass-* utilities. Selected default = glass-surface-subtle + shadow-md; no shared moving indicator.
motion: Each trigger wrapped in Motion preset scaleIn (L418-419) - tabs pop in on mount; content Motion fadeIn. Ink indicator is measured but rendered only inside the glass branch guarded by variant==='underline' (L243) which can never be true there (glass branch is default/pills only) - dead. Reduced motion depends solely on Motion primitive.
a11y: Best of the set: tablist with aria-orientation, role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls/aria-labelledby, arrow/Home/End with loop, activationMode automatic/manual. Gaps: no roving tabindex (every trigger is tabbable), ids derived from value (collisions with multiple Tabs on a page: trigger-${value}), root wrapper role=navigation (L130) - tabs are not a landmark. Duplicate key handling on both list and trigger can double-move focus.
api: Radix-like compound API, forwardRef everywhere, value/defaultValue/onValueChange. Bug: handleValueChange uses 'if (!value)' (L109) so controlled value '' behaves as uncontrolled. Variants default/pills/underline/minimal. Layout hack: behaviour keyed on className.includes('glass-flex-1') (L422-454). registerTrigger runs rAF+setState in a ref callback every render.
ssr: 'use client'; window resize listener in effect; fine.
fake_complexity: Low; the ink indicator is the only dead feature.
target: canonical Tabs; absorb GlassTabBar, GlassTabItem, EnhancedGlassTabs, GlassPageTabs, LiquidGlassTabBar (as variant='liquid'/placement='bottom')
justification: The only tab implementation in this shard with a sound compound API and near-correct WAI-ARIA tabs semantics, so it should become the canonical Tabs. To meet the premium bar it needs a real shared animated indicator on the liquid material (the measured ink is currently dead code), roving tabindex, useId-based ids, removal of the scaleIn-per-trigger mount animation, removal of the className.includes layout hack, and the controlled-'' bug fix.

name: GlassToolbar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level1/level2 - shared primitive; layout duplicated in both classes and inline style (L74 vs L79-87). material='liquid' delegates to LiquidGlassToolbar.
a11y: role=navigation (L70) - a toolbar should be role=toolbar with arrow-key roving focus; it is labelled 'Toolbar'. Liquid branch uses role=toolbar - semantic mismatch between variants.
api: forwardRef, className, ...rest passthrough (rest spread after style - user style overwrites layout). left/center/right slots. scrollEdge/materialVariant only used by liquid branch; scrollEdge ignored by both (see LiquidGlassToolbar).
target: single Toolbar (merge LiquidGlassToolbar; liquid as default material)
justification: Functional slot layout on the shared primitive, but wrong landmark role, no roving focus, and two parallel implementations with diverging semantics. Merge with LiquidGlassToolbar into one role=toolbar component with roving-focus groups.

name: LiquidGlassToolbar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + LiquidGlassEffectGroup, then overrides background with hard-coded white rgba gradient (L94-96). Toolbar buttons fully unstyled (border 0, transparent) - no hover/pressed/focus states (L44-50).
motion: None of its own; glass-transition class only.
a11y: role=toolbar but no roving tabindex/arrow keys (required pattern). Items render visible label AND aria-label=label (redundant). Groups are unlabeled divs unless aria-label provided; no focus-visible styling on buttons since inline style resets.
api: forwardRef, ...props. Declared but unused: scrollEdge (destructured, never used), floating only adds z-40 (no floating appearance), primaryActionId only toggles text color. Data-driven groups AND slot children both supported (two APIs in one).
fake_complexity: scrollEdge and floating are effectively no-ops.
justification: Uses the liquid primitives but neuters the material with a fixed white gradient, ships unstyled buttons without interaction states, and advertises scrollEdge/floating that do nothing. Fold its groups API into the consolidated Toolbar.

name: HeaderUserMenu
material_impl: GlassPopover appearance=glass (shared) + GlassAvatar. Bespoke arbitrary Tailwind: shadow-[0_20px_60px_color-mix(...)], rounded-[14px], ring-white/10; raw text-red-300/red-400/bg-red-500/10 danger colors; status dot bg-green-500 etc. Many invented utility names (glass-text-primary-glass-opacity-80, glass-gradient-primary repeated 3x, glass-via-white-opacity-3) that likely resolve to nothing.
motion: useReducedMotion gates hover scale class, but the class is a runtime-interpolated duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] (L228) that Tailwind cannot generate.
a11y: Trigger aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded, but content is not role=menu and items are not menuitem; no arrow-key navigation, no focus move into menu. Wrapped in <nav role=navigation> (redundant role, wrong landmark for a single menu button). Status color-only in trigger.
api: forwardRef to trigger button. className applied to BOTH the nav wrapper and the button (L98, L229). intent/elevation/tier props declared but ignored. ContrastGuard imported unused. Default fake user 'User'.
justification: Not exported from the package root or any subpath, so it is effectively dead public surface despite stories/tests. It re-implements a dropdown menu without menu semantics or keyboard support, with no-op props and invented utility classes. Rebuild as a thin recipe on GlassMenuPrimitive (role=menu, roving focus) or drop.

name: LiquidGlassTabBar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + EffectGroup; background overridden with near-transparent white gradient 0.105->0.018 (L103-104). Selected tab = inline rgba(255,255,255,0.18) fill (L36). No shared lens/thumb.
motion: Scroll-driven minimize (labels hidden on scroll) via passive listener; instantaneous, no transition; no reduced-motion consideration (none needed since no animation, but minimize is abrupt). minimizeBehavior 'on-scroll' and 'auto' are identical (L72-74).
a11y: Buttons role=tab with aria-selected but NO role=tablist parent, no aria-controls, no arrow keys, all tabbable. When minimized, non-selected tabs lose their visible label and have no aria-label - icon-only tabs with no accessible name if icon provided (L128). Search tab gets sr-only 'Search tab' appended to its name.
api: forwardRef, ...props, controlled only (activeTab/onChange with id strings). accessoryPlacement 'auto' equals 'above'. scrollTargetRef read once in effect (ref.current captured).
fake_complexity: iOS 26 vocabulary (minimizeBehavior, bottomAccessory, searchTabId) mirrored as props but mostly shallow: no morphing, no search tab separation, auto==on-scroll.
target: BottomTabBar (merge GlassBottomNav) built on consolidated Tabs semantics
justification: A floating Liquid Glass bottom tab bar with minimize-on-scroll and a bottom accessory is exactly the iOS 26 flagship pattern, but this is a props-only imitation: broken tab semantics (no tablist), icon-only minimized tabs without names, abrupt minimize with no morph, and duplicate behaviours. Redesign as the flagship mobile tab bar with a spring-animated selection lens, proper tablist/keyboard, and animated minimize respecting reduced motion; merge GlassBottomNav.

name: LiquidGlassBottomAccessory
material_impl: Pure LiquidGlassMaterial radius full - the cleanest material usage in the shard (no overrides).
motion: none; collapsed only drops opacity to 90% (L19).
a11y: Generic div; no region/label. Fine as a container.
api: forwardRef, className, ...props. collapsed is cosmetic only.
fake_complexity: collapsed state does not collapse anything.
justification: A 29-line pill wrapper; correct material usage, but as a standalone export it adds API surface without behaviour (collapsed is fake). Make it a slot/sub-component of the redesigned bottom tab bar with a real collapse transition.

name: LiquidGlassInsetSidebar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial radius 2xl, overridden with hard-coded white gradient (L74-76); selected item inline rgba(255,255,255,0.28) (L30).
motion: none; width snaps between w-20 and w-72.
a11y: aside + inner nav with label (nav re-reads props['aria-label'], which is also spread on the aside - duplicate label). Items are buttons with aria-current=page (should be links for navigation). Collapsed adds aria-label (good). No hover/focus styles (inline reset).
api: forwardRef, ...props. No-ops: collapsible (only adds sr-only text 'Sidebar is fixed'), scrollEdge (unused), backgroundExtension (data-attr only). No onCollapsedChange/toggle. No nested items, header or footer slots.
fake_complexity: backgroundExtension, scrollEdge, collapsible mirror Apple API names without implementation.
justification: The 'inset' presentation is the right modern look, but the component is a flat list of buttons with three no-op Apple-named props and a hard-coded white fill. Make it the inset variant of the single redesigned Sidebar.

name: LiquidGlassInspectorPanel
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial radius 2xl (no overrides) + LiquidGlassScrollEdge top hard - good primitive usage.
a11y: aside aria-label=title, h2 title, sections aria-labelledby (ids from section.id - collision risk). Close button is an unstyled native button showing the letter 'x' (L63-65) - not an icon, no touch target, no focus styling. No Escape handling.
api: forwardRef, ...props, controlled open/onOpenChange. placement 'left' renders identically to 'right' (L48). resizable = CSS resize-x on the aside (crude native grip). Category mismatch: lives in navigation but is a workspace panel.
fake_complexity: placement left/right is cosmetic only; resizable is the browser's native resize handle.
justification: Correct material and scroll-edge primitives, but a literal 'x' close glyph, native CSS resize, no enter/exit transition, no Escape, and placement that does nothing. There is already a GlassInspectorPanel in workspace; merge into that one and give it a real resize handle, icon close button and slide transition.
